title: AI/ML Lead Engineer
description:
Job Title: AI/ML Senior Lead /Team Lead (More Prefer to FinTech Domain)  
Job Level: Senior Level / Team Lead  
Report to: Project Specialist / Solution Architect.  
Department: Technology \-\> Acquiring.  
Organization: Airpay Payment Services Pvt. Ltd (https://www.airpay.co.in/)  
Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra.

Job Summary:

* We are seeking a hands\-on AI/ML Team Lead with deep, relevant FinTech experience to lead the design, development, deployment, and lifecycle management of secure, scalable, production\-grade AI and machine\-learning systems.
* The role will focus on high\-impact payments and financial\-services use cases such as transaction fraud detection, payment\-risk scoring, anomaly detection, customer and merchant risk profiling, credit/risk analytics, transaction monitoring, anti\-money\-laundering (AML) support, chargeback prediction, and operational intelligence.
* The successful candidate will lead ML model training and evaluation, data\-pipeline development, MLOps, system design, production deployment, monitoring, governance, and continuous improvement while ensuring high\-quality delivery within committed timelines.

Skills and Experience:

* 6\+ years of relevant experience in AI/ML, data science, MLOps, data engineering, risk analytics, or software engineering, including 1–3 years of technical\-lead, team\-lead, or people\-management experience.
* 3\+ years of relevant experience in FinTech, payments, banking, lending, insurance, fraud prevention, credit/risk analytics, transaction monitoring, or a comparable regulated financial\-services environment.
* Expert\-level Python proficiency, including writing clean, tested, maintainable, secure, and performance aware production code. Python is compulsory.
* Practical experience applying ML algorithms to FinTech or risk use cases, including Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, Gradient Boosting, decision trees, anomaly\-detection methods such as Isolation Forest, clustering, and ensemble modelling.
* Strong knowledge of tree\-based boosting methods—particularly XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost— and Random Forest for tabular transaction, customer, merchant, and risk datasets. These algorithms are commonly valuable for FinTech problems because they model nonlinear feature interactions effectively; however, the candidate must be able to validate models rigorously and balance predictive performance with explainability and operational needs.
* Experience with ML frameworks and libraries such as scikit\-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, or equivalent tools.
* Experience developing and validating fraud, risk, anomaly\-detection, transaction\-monitoring, or other decisioning models, including treatment of severe class imbalance, delayed labels, concept drift, threshold selection, and cost\-sensitive trade\-offs.
* Ability to evaluate fraud and risk models using more than accuracy, with strong understanding of precision, recall, F1, PR\-AUC, ROC\-AUC, calibration, false positives/negatives, business loss, operational review capacity, and decision latency.
* Strong MLOps experience, including CI/CD, model/data/feature versioning, experiment tracking, reproducible training, automated testing, deployment pipelines, monitoring, alerting, and retraining workflows.
* Strong hands\-on experience with ETL/ELT, streaming, event\-driven, or real\-time data pipelines; knowledge of data quality, orchestration, observability, and feature consistency between training and serving.
* Strong system\-design capability for scalable ML services and platforms, including throughput, low latency scoring, fault tolerance, resilience, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Hands\-on experience building and deploying Docker\-based services and applications.
* Strong working knowledge of Git, including pull requests, code reviews, release management, and collaborative development workflows.
* Required experience with MySQL and PostgreSQL, including SQL, schema design, indexing, query optimisation, data integrity, and secure data\-access practices.
* Experience with RAG architectures, vector search/retrieval concepts, LLM integration, prompt design, evaluation, and secure implementation for enterprise knowledge workflows is desirable.
* Experience with MCP, tool integrations, AI agents, or secure and auditable enterprise AI workflows is desirable.
* Go/Golang experience is a strong advantage. Additional programming languages are an added benefit.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms, container orchestration, message queues/streaming systems, observability tools, infrastructure\-as\-code, and secure deployment practices is desirable.
* Excellent analytical thinking and strong problem\-solving skills, with the ability to convert ambiguous payment, fraud, and risk problems into practical, measurable solutions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, stakeholder\-management capability, and the ability to explain model performance, risks, trade\-offs, and limitations to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated ownership, attention to detail, adaptability, integrity, and ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, deadline\-oriented environment.

title: Principal Engineer – Application Architect
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Principal Engineer – Application Architect
Who is Mastercard?  

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.  

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.  

Overview  

Payments Network Technology is seeking a Principal Engineer to provide technical and delivery leadership across payment\-network initiatives. This role will connect architecture, release coordination, dependency management, and engineering execution across multiple teams.  

Roles and Responsibilities  

* Define and evolve architecture for secure, scalable, and highly available payment\-network services.
* Coordinate technical delivery across teams, including releases, dependencies, defect triage, and resolution of cross\-cutting issues.
* Partner with product and engineering leaders to translate business needs into architecture and implementation direction.
* Lead design reviews and drive decisions on APIs, service interactions, data, resiliency, security, and operational readiness.
* Identify reuse opportunities and promote common engineering patterns and standards.
* Mentor engineers and technical leads across teams.
* Communicate architecture trade\-offs, delivery risks, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Provide technical or product leadership, mentor team members, and drive decisions across multiple workstreams.

  

Essential Skills  

* Extensive software architecture and development experience in large\-scale systems.
* Deep knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, microservices, REST APIs, messaging, event\-driven architecture, SQL/NoSQL, and cloud\-native platforms.
* Experience with secure engineering, DevOps, performance, resiliency, observability, and production\-readiness practices.
* Ability to lead through influence across organizational boundaries.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.


All About You  

* Experience working in Agile delivery environments and across the software development lifecycle.
* Clear communication, collaboration, problem\-solving, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work with globally distributed product, engineering, architecture, operations, and business teams.
* Experience leading SOAR (Solution Architecture Review) and driving technical strategy, architecture alignment, engineering excellence, and risk management across multiple teams.
* Experience creating and reviewing TADs (Technical Architecture Documents) for large\-scale distributed systems, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards, security requirements, resiliency objectives, and long\-term maintainability.
* Demonstrated experience defining and governing cross\-platform architecture, enabling interoperability, reuse, standardization, and consistent engineering practices across multiple products and services.
* Experience designing and implementing multi\-region resiliency architectures, including active\-active and active\-passive deployment patterns, disaster recovery strategies, cross\-region data replication, failover mechanisms, and business continuity solutions.
* Strong understanding of distributed data management, including data replication, consistency models, recovery objectives, and operational considerations across geographic regions.
* Champions operability and maintainability as first\-class design principles, ensuring observability, monitoring, automation, self\-healing capabilities, supportability, and simplified operational management are built into solutions from inception.
* Deep understanding of Mastercard Engineering Principles (or equivalent large\-scale enterprise engineering standards) and a proven ability to apply them consistently across architecture, software design, deployment, resiliency, security, and operational practices.
* Demonstrated ability to balance architecture, business priorities, scalability, security, resiliency, and operational considerations while establishing technology direction for multiple engineering teams.
* Experience defining architecture guardrails, engineering standards, reference implementations, and reusable patterns that improve consistency, quality, and delivery effectiveness across the organization.
* Strong knowledge of reliability engineering practices, including service\-level objectives (SLOs), error budgets, observability, fault isolation, disaster recovery testing, and continuous resilience validation.
* Payments or financial\-services domain knowledge is preferred.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Practical expertise and strong enthusiasm for AI\-driven engineering transformation; automated testing/DevSecOps pipelines, and modern agile engineering methodologies (CI/CD, TDD/BDD, GitOps).

description:

At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

**Job Details**
===============

**Position Summary:**


This job profile description is a standardized, non\-contractual reference description and global reference tool provided for organizational consistency and talent architecture purposes across Cencora. It does not alter actual job duties, responsibilities, reporting lines, working conditions, grading, compensation, or other essential terms and conditions of employment. Actual duties and responsibilities may vary based on business needs, local requirements, and operational practices. Where a team member's role is governed by an employment agreement, local terms and conditions, prior job description or collective bargaining agreement, those documents shall prevail in case of any inconsistency. Mandatory local laws shall also prevail. Defines domain\-level enterprise architecture direction, target\-state patterns, and technical standards across a portfolio of high\-impact initiatives. Guides architecture and delivery decisions across multiple concurrent programs, ensuring alignment to business priorities, enterprise strategy, and operating constraints. Advises senior leaders on complex technical tradeoffs, risks, sequencing, and implications to support critical operational and strategic decisions. Coordinates alignment across engineering, infrastructure, security, data, product, and external stakeholders to advance consistent technical direction and execution. Analyzes complex, ambiguous technical and business challenges and translates them into scalable solutions, standards, and repeatable practices adopted across initiatives. Improves systems, architecture practices, and governance mechanisms to raise reliability, scalability, performance, and functional effectiveness. Builds capability across senior teams and communities of practice through mentoring, architecture reviews, coaching, and reusable guidance.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the definition of end\-to\-end enterprise architecture by curating, and evolving enterprise architecture and solution patterns in alignment with **Cencora’s Pattern Development (PADU)** framework and standards. Promote the reuse of proven architectural design patterns and ensure consistency across solutions.
* Architect and orchestrate decision **flows** with **technology selection standards**, making sure that solutions leverage approved technologies and align with Cencora’s overall enterprise architecture direction. Contribute to **governance of emerging technologies** through the Tech Select process, balancing innovation with strategic alignment.
* Assess and **streamline the application portfolio** by identifying redundancies and overlaps. Propose and guide efforts to **consolidate or modernize** applications, reduce complexity, and optimize the technology landscape in line with business needs.
* Identify and document areas of **technical debt** within our systems and platforms. Influence remediation by incorporating **debt reduction strategies** into architecture **recommendations and roadmaps**, thereby improving long\-term platform health and maintainability.
* Work closely with domain solution architects and engineering teams to ensure that solution designs adhere to **enterprise architecture standards** and use technologies as defined in the PADU matrix. Facilitate cross\-team design reviews and provide guidance to keep implementations consistent with approved patterns and tech stacks. Influence without direct authority, fostering cross\-team **alignment, communication, and consensus** on architectural direction and strategy.
* Define and maintain architecture roadmaps that guide the organization through **modernization, application rationalization, and platform evolution**. Aligning these roadmaps with product and business roadmaps, ensuring architectural initiatives support Cencora’s strategic goals and delivering incremental value.
* Compile and maintain **Application Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)** analysis for key systems and platforms. Provide transparency into application costs (licensing, operations, maintenance) and **share insights** with domain leaders to support informed decision\-making around investments, optimizations, and lifecycle management (advising on cost implications without owning budgets).
* Partner with **Enterprise Architects** to establish **enterprise integration patterns, orchestration standards, and data synchronization** strategies. Define best practices for **real\-time versus batch data integration** and **event\-driven architectures** to enable efficient operational workflows **and robust analytics**.
* Collaborate with **Data \& Analytics teams** and delivery groups to ensure supply chain data is **high\-quality, governed, secure, and “AI\-ready.”** Foster data architectures that support advanced analytics and AI/ML capabilities, enabling insights and innovation in supply chain processes.
* **Guide high\-impact, cross\-domain architectural decisions** and solution designs, maintaining a holistic viewpoint across multiple domains. **Act as a trusted advisor** to supply chain and technology leadership, translating complex architecture decisions into clear **business impacts and financial implications** that support informed decision\-making.
* Mentor junior architects and technical teams, helping to build and scale Cencora’s enterprise and solution architecture capabilities over time. Share best practices and insights, contributing to a culture of excellence and continuous learning.

 **EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* **8\+ years in software/enterprise architecture** or related roles with strong expertise in designing and integrating complex enterprise platforms and business applications. Experience across domains such as **MSO,** supply chain platforms (such as advanced planning systems, **ERP, or WMS/TMS** solutions) are highly valued.
* **Analytical Skills**: Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and make informed recommendations.
* **Communication Skills**: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of conveying complex information clearly to diverse audiences.
* **Collaboration Skills**: Proven ability to work collaboratively across teams and influence stakeholders at various levels within the organization
* **Presentation Skills:** Ability to present and discuss business issues, strategies and technical information in a manner that establishes rapport, persuades others and gain understanding at all levels of the organization
* Strong knowledge of **enterprise architecture frameworks** (e.g., TOGAF) and modern integration patterns, including APIs, real\-time and batch processing, and event\-driven architectures. Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as **SAP S/4HANA, Manhattan Active, Salesforce, CRM platforms, and other ERP** or enterprise application ecosystems, along with exposure to data and analytics technologies.
* Proven ability to **collaborate across business and technology teams**, **Strong communication and consulting skills** with the ability to translate complex architectural concepts into clear business value and technology outcomes.

.

title: Solution Architect
description:
Solution Architect – BFSI Cards \& Payments

**Experience:** 5–10 Years  
**Industry:** BFSI / Banking / Payments  
**Role:** Solution Architect  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Solution Architect** with strong expertise in **BFSI Cards \& Payments** to design and deliver scalable, secure, and cloud\-native solutions. The candidate will work closely with Product, Business, Engineering, and Architecture teams to define solution designs and drive end\-to\-end delivery.

Key Responsibilities

* Define end\-to\-end **Solution Architecture** covering Application, Data, Infrastructure, and Security.
* Design scalable solutions using **Microservices, API\-First, Event\-Driven, Cloud\-Native, and Serverless architectures**.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, BAs, Engineering Leads, System Teams, and RTEs to define optimal system designs.
* Ensure solutions meet functional and non\-functional requirements.
* Create architecture roadmaps, milestones, architectural diagrams, and solution documentation.
* Participate in **PI Planning** and resolve technical dependencies across teams.
* Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture standards, principles, and design patterns.
* Work with development teams to ensure implementation aligns with the target architecture.
* Mentor engineering teams and promote reusable architecture assets and modern engineering practices.

Mandatory Skills

* Solution Architecture \& Architecture Design Patterns
* Microservices \& SOA
* API\-First \& Event\-Driven Architecture
* Cloud\-Native Architecture
* Java, Spring Boot / Quarkus
* REST APIs
* Kafka
* Kubernetes
* OAuth2
* PostgreSQL or any RDBMS
* CI/CD \& DevSecOps concepts

BFSI / Payments Experience

* Strong experience in **Banking, Cards, Payments, or BFSI product engineering**.
* Knowledge of **BIAN, Open Banking, and ISO 20022**.
* Experience with scalable web architectures and data migration.

Good to Have

* Application Re\-architecting
* Architecture Assessment
* Architectural Diagrams
* Architecture Principles \& Design
* Architecture Views \& Viewpoints
* TOGAF or Cloud Architecture certification
* AWS / Azure / GCP certification

Required Qualifications

* 5–10years of experience in Solution Architecture.
* Experience delivering architecture for large programs, digital transformation, or point solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and multitasking abilities.

Pay: ₹889,623\.67 \- ₹2,465,721\.22 per year

* Provident Fund
